items.text: Broncos officially placed RB R.J. Harvey on short-term IR after knee injury in Thursday practice; will miss next four games, eligible to return Week 13 vs Dolphins.
items.why: Knee injury suffered in practice; official team move confirmed by Schefter and Rapoport.
items.implication: Misses 4 games; unique role means no clean handcuff, opens 3-6 targets and carries in DEN backfield/passing game.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for remaining DEN RBs and pass-catchers like Waddle if active.

items.text: Patriots downgraded WR A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) and RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness) to OUT for Week 8 vs Dolphins; neither traveled.
items.why: Brown knee flare-up after limited Wed; Henderson missed practices with illness. Confirmed by team and Rapoport/Schefter reports.
items.implication: NE thin at WR (Douglas/Chism/Williams primary); Stevenson/Kiner/Larison at RB. Maye target volume shifts.
items.opportunity: Elevated roles for remaining NE skill players; handcuff value on Stevenson.

items.text: Seahawks RBs Jadarian Price and Zach Charbonnet no injury designations, both expected to play MNF vs Bears; Charbonnet season debut. Backfield whole per Rapoport.
items.why: Cleared fully; Schefter/Rapoport confirm whole backfield.
items.implication: Committee with Walker/Charbonnet; Price role TBD but available.
items.opportunity: Snap share competition; monitor early usage.

items.text: Saquon Barkley surprisingly off final injury report (hamstring/back) and playing Week 8; Levitan shocked he's not docked more, hard to believe 100%.
items.why: Not on final report despite prior issues; ETR lists IN.
items.implication: Start with caution; volume may be managed but opportunity full if healthy.
items.conflict: Berry HATE/rank low due to concerns.

items.text: RJ Harvey's role so unique no clean replacement; 3-6 more targets now available with him on IR. Waddle also Q (chest).
items.why: Unique usage profile; targets free in DEN offense post-IR.
items.implication: Target spike for WRs/TEs/remaining RBs; no pure handcuff.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE again (quad); cryptic tweet + trade rumors. Levitan thought close last week but another Q tag.
items.why: Unable full practice; rumors swirling per Levitan. ETR lists Q.
items.implication: GTD; if OUT, Allen elevated. Monitor inactives.
items.opportunity: If active, lead back; else backup surge.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka ruled OUT (foot/concussion) for Week 8; second straight miss. ETR projections updated for fallout.
items.why: Foot injury; confirmed OUT on final reports and ETR board. Rapoport noted Bucs status.
items.implication: TB WR depth thins; Godwin/Evans/others absorb targets if active.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining Bucs WRs/TEs.

items.text: Carnell Tate OUT (shoulder) for Week 8 per ETR Sunday injury board; no practice this week.
items.why: Shoulder; listed OUT on ETR comprehensive board alongside Spears.
items.implication: TEN WR targets redistribute; Ridley Q but others elevated.
items.opportunity: Route/target share bump for TEN pass-catchers.

items.text: Lamar Jackson IN/expected to play Week 8 (no designation after ankle); ETR notes small docks on rushing volume.
items.why: Cleared; coach confirmation and final report clean. Levitan docks rushing slightly.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense; Flowers etc. upgrade. Still monitor rush attempts.
items.opportunity: Full QB1 role with possible limited run share early.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) again for Week 8 along with Dontayvion Wicks; Eagles lean on others.
items.why: Hamstring; repeated absence on ETR OUT list and reports.
items.implication: PHI WR targets to Brown/Goedert/others; volume concentration.
items.opportunity: Elevated shares for remaining Eagles pass-catchers.

items.text: After two-TD outing, Levitan would try to sell high on Quinshon Judkins; role concerns ahead.
items.why: Usage not sustainable long-term per Levitan analysis.
items.implication: Sell-high candidate in trades; monitor depth chart.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Zay Flowers as WR5 this week; Lamar unlock + Bills matchup track meet potential.
items.why: Lamar return elevates; soft/high-scoring matchup vs BUF.
items.implication: Strong WR2/flex start with QB1 back.
items.opportunity: Full routes + high target share expected.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry (RB6), Chase Brown (RB8), Josh Jacobs (RB11) for Week 8.
items.why: Matchups and roles favor volume/TDs; Lamar unlock for Henry.

items.text: Berry HATES Saquon Barkley (RB20), Tony Pollard (RB21), Omarion Hampton (RB34) this week.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Saquon IN despite surprise.
